title: FATHER GOD, LET YOUR PRESENCE FINISH WHAT I CANNOT FINISH
text: Beloved, before we even begin this morning, I want you to do something for me. Wherever you are right now, whether you're in your room, in your car, in your office, or even if you're walking, I want you to share this prayer with somebody. Send it to that friend who has been struggling. [music] Send it to that family member who doesn't know how to pray their way through. Send it to that business partner who has been hitting walls they cannot break through. Share it right now because what God is about to release in this atmosphere is not just for you alone. The anointing that breaks the yoke is contagious. It is transferable. And when you become a distribution center of grace, heaven takes note of your life. So pause for a moment and share this with at least three people because the Bible says in Proverbs 11:25, "The liberal soul shall be made fat and he that waterth shall be watered also himself." When you become a channel, you position yourself for a visitation. Share this prayer now and let us enter into the courts of heaven together. Father, in the name of Jesus, we come before your throne this morning with hearts that are hungry, with spirits that are desperate, with souls that are crying out for a divine interruption. We acknowledge this morning that we have come to the end of ourselves. We have tried with our wisdom. We have labored with our strength. We have strategized with our intellect. And [music] we have discovered that there are dimensions of breakthrough that human effort cannot produce. There are levels of victory that our qualification cannot attract. There are territories of glory that our resumeumé cannot access. And so this morning we return to the ancient pathway. We return to the place of dependence. We return to the secret of the supernatural which is the manifest presence of the almighty God. Lift up your voice wherever you are and say, "Father, let your presence finish what I cannot finish. Let your presence complete what my ability has failed to complete. Let your presence perfect what my strength has left [music] imperfect. In the name of Jesus, let your manifest glory step into my situation and do what only divinity can do." You see beloved, there is a profound mystery that I have discovered in my walk with God. And it is this that the presence of God is not just a theological concept. It is not just a doctrine that we study in Bible school. It is not just a song that we sing during worship. The presence of God is the most potent force in the entire universe. When the presence of God shows up, impossibilities bow. When the presence of God invades a situation, the laws [music] of nature are suspended. When the presence of God fills a room, demons flee in terror and angels are commissioned to work on your behalf. The scripture says in Psalm 16:11, "In thy presence is fullness of joy. At thy right hand there are pleasures forever more. But beyond joy, beyond pleasure, there is power in the presence. There is authority in the presence. There is completion in the presence. The Bible gives us a powerful illustration in the book of Exodus chapter 33. Moses had been leading the children of Israel through the wilderness. And God had given him a mandate, a commission, an instruction to bring the people to the promised land. But Moses understood something that many believers have not yet understood. Moses knew that there is a difference between having an assignment and having the presence. You can have a vision without the presence. You can have a plan without the presence. You can have resources without the presence. And so Moses said something that should become the cry of every serious believer. He said in verse 15, "If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence." Moses was essentially saying, "God, I would rather stay in the wilderness with your presence than go to the promised land without your presence. I would rather remain in obscurity with your glory than step into prominence without your manifest backing." And I prophesy to somebody this morning, the season of laboring without the presence is over. The era of struggling without divine assistance is finished. The time of building without heaven's endorsement has come to an end. From this day forward, you shall not move except the presence goes with you. You shall not build except the glory rests upon you. You shall not pursue any vision except the spirit of God gives you the green light. Let the presence of the Lord finish what you cannot finish. Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray for every person under the sound of my voice. I pray that you will arise in their situations. I pray that your presence [music] will locate every unfinished project in their lives. Every business that has stalled, every relationship that has hit a dead end, every vision that has been aborted, every dream that has been deferred, let your presence step in and bring divine completion. The Bible says in Philippians 1:6, "Being confident of this very thing, that he which had begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ. Lord, you are the author and the finisher. You are the beginning and the ending. And every work that you have started in their lives, let your presence bring it to a glorious conclusion in the mighty name of Jesus. Now, I want you to understand something this morning. There are levels of finishing that require more than human participation. There are dimensions of completion that demand a supernatural intervention. You can have all the skills, you can have all the connections, you can have all the capital, [music] you can have all the intelligence, but there are some battles that will only be won when the presence of God shows up. There are some mountains that will only move when the glory of God is manifest. There are some doors that will only open when the spirit of God releases a sovereign access. Look at the life of David. When David was anointed as king over Israel, it was the presence of the Lord that made the difference. The Bible says in 2 Samuel 5:10, "And David went on and grew great, and the Lord God of hosts was with him." It was not just David's military strategy. It was not just his courage. It was not just his previous experience of killing the lion and the bear and golad. It was the presence of the Lord that made him great. Every battle he fought, he inquired of the Lord. Every decision he made, he sought the face of God. And the presence of the Lord became his secret weapon. The presence of the Lord became his competitive advantage. The presence of the Lord became the distinguishing factor between him and every other king in Israel. And I declare over your life this morning, the presence of the Lord shall become your distinguishing factor in your workplace. People will recognize that there is something different about you. In your business, competitors will wonder what is the secret of your success. In your family, generations will testify that there was a shift when you began to walk in the manifest presence of God. The presence shall finish what you cannot finish. Father, [snorts] I pray in the name of Jesus that every person hearing this prayer will experience a fresh baptism of your presence. Let your glory fall upon them right now like the dew of Hemon. Let your presence surround them like a shield. Let your glory overshadow them like a cloud. And everywhere they go, let men and women recognize that they have been with Jesus. Let the fragrance of your presence follow them into every room, into every meeting, into every negotiation, into every conversation, and let your presence speak on their behalf when they do not know what to say. Let your presence fight for them when they do not have the strength to fight. Let your presence open doors for them that no man can shut. You see, there is something I need you to understand about the mystery of divine presence. When the presence of God rests [music] upon your life, you begin to access supernatural speed. Things that should take you 10 years will happen in 10 months. Processes that should take a lifetime will be compressed into a season. The Bible talks about this in Isaiah 60-22 where God says, "A little one shall become a thousand and a small one a strong nation. I the Lord will hasten it in his time." [music] The word hasten means to accelerate, to speed up, to compress time. And when the presence of God is upon your life, God hastens your destiny. God accelerates your purpose. God compresses your timeline. I prophesy to somebody, you are entering into a season of supernatural speed. What the enemy stole through delay, the presence of God will restore through acceleration. What you lost in the years of wandering, the presence of God will recover in a moment. What the devil thought he had successfully aborted, the presence of God will resurrect and bring to completion. The presence shall finish what you cannot finish. Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak to every delayed blessing. I command acceleration right now. Let every vision that has been delayed come back to life in the name of Jesus. Let every promise that has been postponed be suddenly activated. Let every prophecy that seems to be taking too long receive divine acceleration. The Bible says in Habachok 2:3, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak and not lie. Though it tar, wait for it, because it will surely come, it will not try." Father, let the appointed time of fulfillment [music] manifest. For every person praying this prayer, let what has been waiting in the realm of the spirit be released into the realm of the physical. Let heaven open and let the blessings that have been stored up be poured out without measure. Now I want to take you into a deeper dimension this morning. The presence of God does not just finish what you started. The presence of God also finishes what other started against you. Let me say that again because this is critical. The presence of God finishes the evil agenda that was initiated against your life. The presence of God completes the destruction of every satanic project [music] that was designed to destroy you. When the presence of God shows up in your life, every weapon that has been fashioned will not prosper. Every tongue that has risen against you in judgment will be condemned. Every plot that [music] has been hatched in the secret chambers of darkness will be exposed and destroyed. The Bible gives us a powerful example in the book of Esther. Hamman had built a gallows. He had crafted an evil plan. He had manipulated the political system. He had secured the signature of the king for the destruction of the Jews. Everything was in place for the anihilation of God's people. But there was one factor that Haman did not calculate. The presence of God. And when the presence of God stepped into the situation, the entire narrative changed. The very gallows that Haman built for Modcai became the instrument of his own death. The very decree that was meant to destroy the Jews became the platform for their elevation. The presence of God finished the evil that Haman could not finish. I prophesy to somebody right now. Every evil plan that has been fashioned against you is about to backfire. Every trap that has been set for your downfall is about to catch the enemy. Every weapon that has been fought for your destruction is about to be turned against the one who created it. The presence of the Lord shall arise and scatter your enemies. The presence of the Lord shall fight for you while you hold your peace. The presence of the Lord shall finish every evil agenda and turn your mourning into dancing. Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak destruction to every evil altar that has been raised against your children. I command fire from heaven to consume every sacrifice that has been offered for their downfall. Let every witchcraft gathering that has mentioned their names be scattered by divine confusion. [music] Let every monitoring spirit that has been assigned to track their progress be struck with blindness. Let every evil hand that has been stretched [music] out to harm them be paralyzed. Let every tongue that has spoken curses be silenced. Let every eye that has looked upon them with envy be closed in the name of Jesus. Let your presence arise and finish every evil work. You know, there is a reason why the enemy fights the presence of God in the life of believers. The devil understands that as long as he can keep you distracted, as long as he can keep you busy with religious activities but disconnected from the present, he can limit your impact, he can frustrate your progress, he can delay your destiny. But the moment you discover the secret of the presence, the moment you learn how to cultivate intimacy with God, the moment you prioritize the presence above everything else, you become a dangerous weapon in the hands of the Almighty. Moses understood this secret. David understood this secret. Elijah understood this secret. Jesus himself, though he was the son of God, prioritized the presence of the father. The Bible says in Mark 1:35, "And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed." Jesus knew that the demands of ministry would drain him. He knew that the needs of the multitude would stretch him. He knew that the opposition from the Pharisees would pressure him. And so he made a decision to prioritize time in the presence of the father. And it was from that place of intimacy that he drew the strength to finish his assignment. It was from that place of communion that he received the wisdom to navigate complex situations. It was from that place of divine connection that he operated in a dimension of power that confounded his enemies. And I prophesy to you this morning, the same grace that was upon Jesus is available to you. The same presence that empowered him to finish his assignment will empower you to finish yours. The same glory that rested upon him will rest upon you. But you must make a decision. You must prioritize the presence. You must create space for intimacy. You must disconnect from the noise and the distractions and the busyiness and the chaos. And you must learn to wait in his presence until the glory comes down. Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray for a fresh hunger for your presence. Let every person praying this prayer begin to crave your presence more than they crave success. Let them desire your glory more than they desire promotion. Let them seek your face more than they seek provision. create in them a hunger that cannot be satisfied with religious activities. A thirst that cannot be quenched with mere doctrine. A desperation that will not settle for anything less than a genuine encounter with your manifest presence. Let them become addicted to your presence. Let them become drunk with your glory. Let them become consumed with a passion for your face. Now, let me show you something powerful in the scriptures. In 2 Chronicles chapter 5, when Solomon had finished building the temple, the Bible says that the priests brought in the ark of the [music] covenant. The musicians began to worship, the singers lifted their voices in praise, and then something extraordinary happened. Verse 13 says, "It came even to pass as the trumpeters and singers were as one to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the Lord. And when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and symbols and instruments of music, and praised the Lord, saying, "For he is good, for his mercy endureth forever." That then the house was filled with a cloud, even the house of the Lord. And look at verse 14. So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud. For the glory of the Lord had filled the house of God. When the presence of God showed up, the professionals could not function. The trained ministers could not operate. The experienced priests could not stand because when the glory comes, human ability becomes irrelevant. When the presence manifests, your skills take a backseat. When the cloud fills the house, God takes over and finishes what you cannot finish. I decree over your life this morning, the glory of God is about to fill your house. The presence of God is about to invade your situation. And when the glory comes, you will no longer struggle to make things happen. You will no longer strive to force doors open. You will no longer manipulate and scheme and politick your way to the top. You will simply rest in the presence and the presence will do what you cannot do. The presence will open what you cannot open. The presence will heal what you cannot heal. The presence will restore what you cannot restore. The presence will finish what you cannot finish. Father, I speak to every struggle right now. I speak to every area of their lives where they have been laboring in their own strength. I speak to every project that they have been trying to complete with their own wisdom. I speak to every battle that they have been trying to fight with their own weapons. And I decree enough is enough. Let your presence step in. Let your glory take over. Let your power be made perfect in their weakness. The Bible says in 2 Corinthians 12:9, "My grace is sufficient for thee, for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Lord, where they are weak, let your strength be manifest. Where they have failed, let your presence bring success. Where they have fallen short, let your glory make up the difference. There is something else I want you to see this morning. The presence of God not only finishes what you cannot finish, but the presence of God also perfects what you have already finished. Let me explain. There are some things that you have completed in your own strength, in your own timing, with your own resources, and they are functional, but they are not excellent. They work, but they do not carry glory. They are done, but they are not anointed. And when the presence of God touches what you have already finished, he transforms it from ordinary to extraordinary. He elevates it from common to consecrated. He upgrades it from natural to supernatural. Look at the feeding of the 5,000. The disciples had five loaves and two fish. That was what they had. That was their contribution. That was their human effort. But when Jesus took what they had and blessed it in the presence of the father, what was ordinary became miraculous. What was insufficient became abundant. What was limited became limitless. The presence of God perfected what the disciples had already provided. I prophesy to somebody, what you have already built is about to receive a divine upgrade. What you have already started is about to be perfected by the presence of God. What you have been working on with your natural ability is about to be saturated with supernatural anointing. God is about to take what is good and make it great. He's about to take what is functional and make it phenomenal. He's about to take what is successful and make it significant. The presence shall perfect what you have already finished. Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray for divine perfection. Let your presence touch every work of their hands. Let your glory rest upon every business, every ministry, every project, every relationship, every vision. And let what was built in the natural be transformed by the supernatural. Let what was started in their strength be completed in your power. Let what was initiated in their wisdom be perfected in your glory. Touch it, Lord. Anoint it, Lord. Perfect it, Lord. Let your presence finish what they cannot finish and perfect what they have already finished. Now I want to talk to you about the cost of the presence because everything that is valuable comes with a price. The presence of God is not cheap. It is not something that you can access through casual Christianity. It is not something that you can experience through convenient commitment. The presence of God demands everything. It requires total surrender. It necessitates complete abandonment. It insists on absolute consecration. Moses spent 40 days and 40 nights on the mountain to encounter the presence. David danced before the ark with all [music] his might, undignified, unreserved, unconcerned about what people thought because he was [music] desperate for the presence. Daniel prayed three times a day, risking his life because he valued the presence more than he valued his safety. Paul counted all things as loss for the excellence of the knowledge of Christ Jesus because he understood that the presence is worth more than everything else combined. And I'm asking you this morning, what are you willing to pay for the presence? What are you willing to sacrifice to experience the glory? What are you willing to surrender to access the manifest power of God? Will you fast when others are feasting? Will you pray when others are sleeping? Will you worship when others are complaining? Will you seek his face when others are seeking his hand? The presence is available, but it comes with a cost. And those who are willing to pay the price will experience dimensions of God that the casual believer will never know. Father, I pray for a spirit of consecration. Let there be a holy dissatisfaction with casual Christianity. Let there be a hunger that refuses to be satisfied with secondhand testimonies. Let there be a thirst that will not settle for hearing about your presence but must experience your presence. Raise up a generation of seekers, a company of worshippers, a remnant of intercessors who will pay the price to access the depths of your glory. And as they seek you, let them find you. As they knock, let the door be opened. As they hunger, let them be filled with your presence. Let me give you a practical key this morning. If you want the presence of God to finish what you cannot finish, you must create an atmosphere that attracts the presence. The presence of God does not manifest in an atmosphere of unbelief. The presence of God does not come down in an environment of rebellion. The presence of God does not rest where there is unforgiveness, bitterness, malice, and strife. You must prepare the ground. You must sanctify the atmosphere. You must cleanse the environment. The Bible says in Psalm 100 verse4, "Enter into his gates with thanksgiving and into his courts with praise. Be thankful unto him and bless his name." There is a protocol for accessing the presence. You enter with thanksgiving. You come with gratitude. You approach with worship. You don't come complaining. You don't come murmuring. You don't come with a list of demands. You come with a heart of appreciation, acknowledging that he is good. Recognizing that his mercy endures forever, celebrating who he is before you. Present what you need. Right now, wherever you are, I want you to begin to thank God. Open your mouth and say, "Father, I thank you for life. I thank you for health. I thank you for strength. I thank you for provision. I thank you for protection. I thank you for grace. I thank you for mercy. I thank you for favor. I thank you that I am still here, still standing, still believing, still trusting, still hoping. I magnify your name. I exalt your name. I glorify your name. You are worthy. You are faithful. You are awesome. You are glorious. Let thanksgiving fill the atmosphere right now. Father, as they worship you, as they magnify your name, as they honor you with thanksgiving and praise, I pray that your presence will begin to manifest. Let the cloud of your glory fill the room where they are. Let the tangible weight of your presence rest upon them. Let them feel your touch. Let them sense your nearness. Let them know that you are right there with them. Closer than a brother, more present than the air they breathe. Manifest yourself, Lord. Show up in power. Come with glory. Let your presence finish what they cannot finish. I want to prophesy to somebody this morning. There is a project that you started years ago [music] and it has remained incomplete. Every time you try to move forward, something blocks your progress. Every time you gather resources, something happens and the resources disappear. Every time you make plans, the plans are frustrated. And you have been tempted to abandon it, to give up, to conclude that maybe it was not God's will. But I hear the spirit of the Lord saying, "Do not abort what I have initiated. Do not abandon what I have authorized. That project is from me. And the reason it has not been completed is because I have been waiting for you to invite my presence into the process. You have been trying to finish it in your strength with your wisdom through your connections. But I am saying to you today, surrender it to me. Let my presence take over. Let my glory step in and I will finish what you cannot finish. I will complete what has remained incomplete. [music] I will perfect what has been imperfect. Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak to that unfinished project. I command divine completion. Let every obstacle be removed. Let every hindrance be destroyed. Let every barrier be broken down. And let your presence step in and bring it to a [music] glorious conclusion. The Bible says in Zechariah 4:6-7, "Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, sayeth the Lord of hosts, who art thou, oh great mountain, before Zerubbabel, thou shalt become a plain, and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, grace, grace unto it. Father, every mountain standing before their project, let it become a plane. Every impossibility, let it bow. Every difficulty, let it dissolve. And let them bring forth the headstone with shoutings of grace. Grace unto it. As we begin to come to the close of this prayer, I want to remind you of something very important. The presence of God is not just for special occasions. The presence of God is not just for Sunday morning worship services. The presence of God is not just for conferences and crusades and revival meetings. The presence of God is meant to be your daily reality. It is meant to be your lifestyle. It is meant to be your atmosphere. You are supposed to walk in the presence, talk in the presence, walk in the presence, sleep in the presence, eat in the presence, live in the presence. Brother Lawrence, the famous monk who wrote the practice of the presence of God, learned how to maintain an awareness of God's presence even while washing dishes in the monastery kitchen. He said that there was no difference between his time of formal prayer and his time of manual labor because he had learned how to stay conscious of God's presence in every moment. And that is the invitation for you this morning. Don't just encounter the presence during your morning devotion and then disconnect for the rest of the day. Learn to cultivate a continuous awareness. Learn to live in the secret place. Learn to abide in the shadow of the Almighty. Father, I pray that they will become carriers of your presence. Let your presence rest upon them permanently. Let your glory become their covering. Let your spirit be their constant companion. And everywhere they go, let the presence go with them. In their homes, let your presence dwell. In their offices, let your presence manifest. [music] In their businesses, let your presence attract divine customers. In their marriages, let your presence [music] bring healing and restoration. In their children, let your presence bring transformation. Let them become mobile tabernacles, walking temples, living sanctuaries where your presence dwells continually. I decree and I declare the presence of the Lord shall finish what you cannot finish. Every incomplete project, the present shall complete it. Every unfinished business, the present shall perfect it. Every broken relationship, the present shall restore it. Every delayed promise, the present shall accelerate it. Every frustrated vision, the present shall fulfill it. From this day forward, you shall not labor alone. You shall not struggle in isolation. You shall not fight in your own strength. The presence of the Lord shall go with you. The presence of the Lord shall fight for you. The presence of the Lord shall finish what you cannot finish. In the mighty name of Jesus, I seal this prayer. I release the anointing. I activate the prophecy and I declare that it is done. Let every amen in heaven say amen. Let every angel assign to your life say amen. Let every prophet and every intercessor who has been praying for your breakthrough say amen. It is finished. It is done. The presence has taken over. receive your completion in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.
